sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: It should be noted that when reloading the weapon with a round still in the chamber, said round will be ejected onto the ground and can be recovered by being picked up. The rifle can contain a max of 5+1 rounds, but can only be loaded in the field up to 4+1. If reloaded by dragging the ammo to the rifle in your inventory while it is not currently being held, it can be reloaded back to 5.
